# Feature Plan Template

> **How to use this template:**
> 1. Copy this file to the appropriate docs subfolder (e.g., `docs/Planning/frontend/`)
> 2. Rename the file following the pattern: `FEAT<date>-<service>-<short-description>.md`
>    - Example: `FEAT202605271230-frontend-new-dashboard.md`
> 3. Fill in each section below with feature planning details
> 4. Delete this instruction block when done

---

## Feature Overview

**What is this feature and why are we building it?**

Provide a high-level description of the feature including:
- What problem does it solve?
- Why is it important?
- What are the main benefits?

---
